card.name: Words just before "without" or "no known"
card.fires_on: A small word or comma right before a phrase meaning "without", such as "no known reason", "in the absence of" or "without a history of". It marks the spot where "without" could come next.

modes.label: Before "no known" cause
modes.description: A preposition or adverb leads into a phrase saying something happens with no known reason or cause.
modes.example: A bone that breaks<< for>> no known reason.

modes.label: Before absence phrases
modes.description: A linking word such as "in" or "even" precedes "without a history of" or "in the absence of".
modes.example: and very rarely,<< in>> patients without a history of seizures and no

modes.label: Before "without" after a measure
modes.description: A number or word ends a finding, and "without" comes next to say no symptoms came with it.
modes.example: severe neutropenia (ANC <500/mm <<3>> without any associated symptoms)
